positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Investigate and resolve defects in C++ code to better meet requirements
•	Innovate MATLAB scripts for more accurate and detailed performance analysis
•	Lead the design and implementation of new digital signal processing features
•	Modularize C/C++ code for reuse across products utilizing ClearCase for version control
•	Assist in onboarding new team members, guiding them through the software development process

•	Optimized C++ programs to optimize CUDA for performance improvements
•	Redesigned logic across multiple implementations to evaluate CUDA's impact
•	Conducted runtime analysis to demonstrate improvements, contributing to a pilot program 
•	Proposed performance enhancements after analyzing timing logs and identifying existing bottlenecks

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
•	Create an inclusive living environment with a strong emphasis on community and academics 
•	Resolve problems from maintenance repairs to roommate mediations
•	Market and budget community programs to promote overall well-being, growth and understanding

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on web design and crowdsourcing using Amazon Mechanical Turk
•	Used a variety of Application Program Interfaces (e.g., Google Maps and Amazon Web Services)
•	Designed user friendly tasks using HTML code to gather mass data
•	Verified quality of human responses to ensure accurate data for the machine learning algorithm

positions.title: Systems Engineering Intern
